0022600228.text: The Detroit Pistons (7-3) arrive on a one-game winning streak, sitting first in the Central and third in the East, and they are 4-1 on the road. The Washington Wizards (4-7) have lost four straight and are 10th in the East, 2.5 games back in the Southeast, and their last ten games are 3-7. Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise), Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and Ugonna Onyenso (foot, day-to-day and a game-time decision), while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The Pistons lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-111 win in Detroit on November 9, and they also won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
